Question ID: MCR_U03_L05_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.MCR.DL.3

Which response best supports this correlation and causation skill: identify correlation without claiming causation?

answer.text: Use cautious claim language and connect the conclusion to the evidence.

feedback.text: Correct. Responsible data interpretation avoids claiming causation unless the evidence supports it.

answer.text: Claim that association always proves causation.

feedback.text: This is the common misconception; association alone does not prove cause and effect.

answer.text: Ignore other possible explanations.

feedback.text: Other factors can explain an observed relationship.

answer.text: Reject all data claims automatically.

feedback.text: Data claims should be evaluated carefully, not automatically rejected.
